content.body:
Nicknamed the Pan, this reliable armored car was the standard recon vehicle for the French Army, generally assigned with a battalion of motorcycle infantry. Also known as the AMD 178 or the Panhard Mle.1935, it was a powerful and advanced vehicle for its time, with fore and aft facing drivers, a rear-mounted engine, and the SA.Mle.37 25mm AT gun which was effective against most early German armor.
Unfortunately, like most armoured cars of the time it was underpowered. It also lacked independent suspension and, inexplicably for a recon vehicle, only command versions were equipped with radios. Nevertheless, they performed admirably in the field; when the Germans captured about 190 of these vehicles at the Fall of France, they didn't hesitate to re-equip them and pack them off for the invasion of Russia.
Control Variations: Driver starts with closed vision port, can zoom on vision slit (numpad . or Del key), or open vision port for better view (O) with subsequent zoom (numpad . or Del key). No control panel view. Commander has vision port but cannot zoom. Gunner has no viewport, AP ammunition only.
Panhards are excellent scout vehicles, if a little difficult to control at high speeds. Avoid hills, or approach them obliquely, 105hp is not much when pushing an 8 ton vehicle up a steep grade. The color helps them to blend into the background quite well, stop frequently and look around. The 25mm is a capable gun, but ambushing should be done carefully with the targets only engaged if there is a reasonable chance of success, and a clear exit route available. You do not have enough armor to stand and fight, dont bother. Panny's ... as they are known ... are good for recon patrol: they are quiet and unobtrusive. When setting up, remember that your whip antennas are very distinctive, be sure there is high enough cover behind you to cover their silhouette completely.
A pair of Panhards, working ambush in tandem along a resupply route are extremely hard to counter, and can cut off a town completely.
content.brief: TYPE: Armoured Car ARMAMENT: 25mm HV Main gun 1 x 7.9mm MG WEIGHT: 8300 kg SPEED (road): 72 km/h
